scripts.check-types: corepack pnpm --filter @scriptr/api check-types && corepack pnpm --filter scriptr-next check-types && corepack pnpm --filter scriptr-sanity check-types && corepack pnpm --filter @scriptr/optimizer check-types
scripts.clean: rm -rf next/node_modules hono/node_modules sanity/node_modules shared/node_modules optimizer/node_modules node_modules next/.next sanity/.sanity next/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo hono/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.dev: corepack pnpm dev:next & corepack pnpm dev:hono & corepack pnpm dev:sanity & corepack pnpm dev:optimizer
scripts.gen:api-endpoints: corepack pnpm --filter @scriptr/api exec tsx scripts/generate-endpoints.ts && corepack pnpm format
scripts.gen:api-types: corepack pnpm --filter @scriptr/api gen:types && corepack pnpm format
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @scriptr/api test && corepack pnpm --filter @scriptr/optimizer test && corepack pnpm --filter @scriptr/shared test
